findings.claim: The analysis rules out adopting another CDC service even though it did not evaluate the CDC solution category.
findings.evidence: The WAL section states, "No rewrite of replication parsing or adoption of another CDC service is justified by this bounded search," while the research scope says, "Tier 4: not used. Broad stack comparisons would not resolve the concrete adapter defects" and the only WAL candidate evaluated is "cand-002: pg_walstream 0.6.3."
findings.suggested_fix: Change the conclusion to say alternative CDC services were not evaluated in this bounded pass, or add a follow-up evaluation of relevant CDC services/libraries before making a no-adoption recommendation.

findings.claim: The machine-readable gap coverage omits F10 even though the candidate evaluations and build-required entries claim F10 was partially addressed.
findings.evidence: `gaps_addressed` is `["F01", "F03", "F07", "F08"]`, but cand-001 has `fit_for_gap`: "F01/F03/F10: durable event history, replay and projection population", the build-required entry has `capability_gap_id`: "F03/F10", and analysis.md says, "No completed coverage is claimed for F10 as a whole: only its broker recovery concerns were investigated here."
findings.suggested_fix: Either include F10 in `gaps_addressed` with a partial/limited coverage marker, or remove F10 from candidate fit/build-required claims and keep it solely in the backlog.
